design_principle: Reimplement useful historical-engine ideas cleanly without restoring sensitive files or unreliable parameters.

challengers.name: Challenger A — Draw-Calibrated Poisson
challengers.observed_evidence: Draw is predicted as the 1X2 class in 0.5% of validation and 0.0% of test matches versus actual rates of 24.0% and 31.8%.
success_gates: reduce absolute draw calibration gap on validation and test
improve test log loss and Brier score
do not reduce accuracy by more than 0.01
do not increase high-confidence wrong predictions

challengers.name: Challenger B — Dixon-Coles Rho Optimized
challengers.observed_evidence: 1-1 is modal in 63.8% of validation and 67.7% of test predictions.
challengers.expected_benefit: improve low-score calibration and reduce modal 1-1 concentration
challengers.risk: optimizing exact scores while worsening probabilistic metrics
success_gates: improve validation and test log loss or Brier score
reduce modal 1-1 concentration
improve draw calibration
do not increase high-confidence wrong predictions

challengers.name: Challenger C — Competition-Weighted Poisson
challengers.observed_evidence: Africa Cup of Nations test is the weakest eligible competition segment with log loss 1.0796.
challengers.expected_benefit: improve weak competition segments without degrading major tournaments
success_gates: improve aggregate validation and test log loss and Brier score
improve AFCON test performance
avoid material regression in major tournament segments

challengers.name: Challenger D — Time-Decay Poisson
challengers.problem_targeted: temporal drift and stale team strengths
challengers.observed_evidence: Season 2023 validation is the weakest eligible season segment with log loss 1.0702.
challengers.expected_benefit: improve test stability with greater weight on recent matches
challengers.risk: reducing effective sample size for sparse teams
success_gates: improve validation and test log loss and Brier score
show stable results for half-lives 12, 24 and 36 months
preserve effective sample safeguards

challengers.name: Challenger E — Elo-Prior Poisson
challengers.observed_evidence: 39/75 validation teams and 60/93 test teams have fewer than five matches in their split.
challengers.expected_benefit: improve low-sample fallback and favorite calibration
challengers.risk: Elo overwhelming historical evidence or leaking current ratings
success_gates: use only pre-match or chronologically reconstructed Elo
improve low-sample team log loss and Brier score
reduce high-confidence wrong favorites

challengers.name: Challenger F — Combined Candidate
challengers.observed_evidence: Multiple independent defects were identified by V1.0.
challengers.expected_benefit: combine only causal improvements that passed isolated evaluation
challengers.risk: complexity hiding which component causes gains or regressions
success_gates: include only independently successful components
beat prototype, V0.9 and included isolated challengers
pass all promotion protocol gates

promotion_rules: beat calibrated_simple_poisson_v0.9 on validation and test
reduce at least one major V1.0 defect
do not modify World Cup 2026 predictions before explicit approval
preserve or explicitly version JSON contracts
do_not_modify: historical train validation and test splits
